sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri V. P. Singh - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri D. K. Paroha - Govt. Advocate for the State and Shri Ni
 Advocate for the objector.

Order 
This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023 who is in jail since 6.3.2024 relating to Crime No.142/2024, registered at Police Station-Crime Branch District- Bhopal (MP) for the offence under Sections 420, 409, 120-B, 201,
467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the application.
4. Bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
5. In change circumstances, applicant is at liberty to file repeat bail application.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/ 2 MCRC-22043-2024 (VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
